name: NERO Chain Docs Skills
description: Skill catalog for agents interacting with NERO Chain documentation. Each skill maps to an MCP tool at https://docs-mcp.nerochain.io and to documented behavior in https://docs.nerochain.io.

skills.name: search_docs
skills.description: Full-text search across NERO Chain documentation pages.
skills.whenToUse: User asks about any NERO Chain concept, API, tool, or tutorial and you need to locate the authoritative source.

query.description: Search query in English or Japanese.

skills.name: get_page
skills.description: Fetch the full markdown content of a specific NERO docs page.
skills.whenToUse: You know the exact URL path (e.g., from search_docs results) and need the full content for citation or summarization.

skills.name: list_sections
skills.description: Return the navigation tree of NERO Chain docs.
skills.whenToUse: When you need to understand the taxonomy of the docs or enumerate available sections.

skills.name: get_api_method
skills.description: Return the JSON-RPC signature, parameters, and examples for a Paymaster API method.
skills.whenToUse: User asks how to call a specific Paymaster method or wants request/response shapes.

skills.name: get_code_example
skills.description: Return curated code snippets for common integration tasks.
skills.whenToUse: User wants runnable example code for a task like deploying their first contract, sending a gasless transaction, or integrating the AA wallet UI.

skills.name: get_faq
skills.description: Return entries from the NERO Chain FAQ, optionally filtered by topic.
skills.whenToUse: User asks a question that likely has a canonical FAQ answer (e.g., testnet faucet, supported wallets, block explorer).

skills.name: get_integration_config
skills.description: Return structured reference configuration for integrating NERO Chain into web apps: network parameters, pre-deployed contract addresses, paymaster payment types, required/optional environment variables, Web3Auth setup, and security rules.
skills.whenToUse: Agent needs to produce a .env file, validate a user's config, wire up Web3Auth + userop, or answer questions about chain IDs, RPC endpoints, EntryPoint address, SimpleAccountFactory, staking contract, etc. Returns JSON, not markdown — no parsing required.

network.description: When topic=env-vars, render values for this network.
